descendents|bonus fat.title: Bonus Fat
descendents|bonus fat.description: Bonus Fat is a compilation album by the American punk rock band the Descendents, released in 1985 through New Alliance Records. It combines the band's 1979 debut single "Ride the Wild" / "It's a Hectic World" with their 1981 Fat EP and the track "Global Probing" from the 1981 New Alliance compilation Chunks. The compilation's cover combines guitarist Frank Navetta's illustration for the Fat EP with a caricature of singer Milo Aukerman drawn by Jeff "Rat" Atkins.

secret machines|now here is nowhere.title: Now Here Is Nowhere
secret machines|now here is nowhere.description: Now Here is Nowhere is the debut studio album by American rock band Secret Machines. It was released on May 18, 2004. The songs on the album are reminiscent of Pink Floyd and Led Zeppelin, with krautrock and shoegaze influences.

dangerous toys|dangerous toys.title: Dangerous Toys
dangerous toys|dangerous toys.description: Dangerous Toys is the debut album by Texas hard rock band Dangerous Toys, released in 1989. It includes the singles "Teas'n Pleas'n" and "Scared," the former covered by Shadows Fall on Fallout from the War, the latter a tribute to Alice Cooper. "Sportin' a Woody" was also released as a single to promote the album.

...and you will know us by the trail of.artist: ...And You Will Know Us By The Trail Of Dead
...and you will know us by the trail of.title: Source Tags & Codes
...and you will know us by the trail of.description: Source Tags & Codes is the third album by American rock band ...And You Will Know Us by the Trail of Dead and the first distributed by a major record label. It was released on February 26, 2002 to wide critical acclaim. The album is often cited as the band's finest work.

van halen|a different kind of truth.title: A Different Kind Of Truth
van halen|a different kind of truth.description: A Different Kind of Truth is the twelfth and final studio album by American rock band Van Halen. Released on February 7, 2012, by Interscope Records, this is Van Halen's only studio album on Interscope and its first album of studio material with lead singer David Lee Roth since 1984. Likewise, A Different Kind of Truth was Van Halen's first studio album since 1998's Van Halen III, as well as their only studio album recorded without bassist Michael Anthony, who had played bass on all of the band's previous albums; Eddie Van Halen's son Wolfgang replaced Anthony for the album, making this his only studio album with the band. It would also be Van Halen's final studio album before Eddie's death and the group's subsequent disbandment in 2020.

frodus|and we washed our weapons in the.title: And We Washed Our Weapons In The Sea
frodus|and we washed our weapons in the.description: And We Washed Our Weapons in the Sea is the fifth and final studio album by American post-hardcore band Frodus, which was released posthumously in 2001. The album received very positive feedback from critics and fans alike, and is considered as the band's best effort.

the flaming lips|the terror.title: The Terror
the flaming lips|the terror.description: The Terror is the thirteenth studio album by American rock band the Flaming Lips, released on April 1, 2013 worldwide and April 16 in the U.S., on Warner Bros in the United States and Bella Union in the United Kingdom. It is the first album for band member Derek Brown who joined the band in 2009 for touring in support of Embryonic and last with drummer Kliph Scurlock.

danzig|danzig iii: how the gods kill.title: Danzig III: How The Gods Kill
danzig|danzig iii: how the gods kill.description: Danzig III: How the Gods Kill is the third studio album by American heavy metal band Danzig, and the highest to chart at the time of its release in 1992 on Def American Recordings. It was reissued in 1998 by Def American's successor, American Recordings.

danzig|danzig ii - lucifuge.title: Danzig II - Lucifuge
danzig|danzig ii - lucifuge.description: Danzig II: Lucifuge is the second studio album by American heavy metal band Danzig. It was released in 1990 on Def American Recordings and was reissued in the US and UK in 1998 by Def American's successor, American Recordings.

r.e.m.|collapse into now.title: Collapse Into Now
r.e.m.|collapse into now.description: Collapse into Now is the fifteenth and final studio album by American alternative rock band R.E.M., released on March 7, 2011, on Warner Bros. Produced by Jacknife Lee, who previously worked with the band on Accelerate (2008), the album was preceded by the singles "It Happened Today", "Mine Smell Like Honey", "Überlin" and "Oh My Heart".

protomartyr|hotel usona.description: Hotel Usona is the seventh studio album by American post-punk band Protomartyr, released on September 25, 2026 on Domino. Produced by Dave Fridmann, the album was preceded by the singles "Sounds We Cannot Hear", "Feed the Sewer" and "Exalted Eagles".
